title: Deftones announce a 2027 North American tour
summary: The 23-date run starts in Dallas in May, with Knocked Loose and julie in support.
body:
Deftones have announced a 23-date tour of North America for spring 2027.

The run begins in Dallas on 5 May and ends in Toronto on 20 June. Stops along the way include the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles and Forest Hills Stadium in New York.

Support acts

Knocked Loose and julie will support the California band on the tour, which was announced on Thursday 12 November. Fans can register now for the ticket presale.

Sources: Billboard, Consequence, Loudwire.
